prompt: Knox learns to share the red truck
title: Share the Red Truck
irony: Knox hogs the red truck to keep the fun, yet the fun starts only when turns make it shared.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Sun lights the street; Knox hugs the shiny red truck by the curb.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Knox claims the red truck for a speedy solo haul and dares Benny to catch him.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Benny asks for a turn, Hattie shouts a swap dare, and Knox clutches the truck tighter.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Kids chant the red-truck hook round the truck as Knox pouts behind it.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Knox starts a one-driver race, tips the red truck over, and waves Benny back.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Knox sits solo in the dust while Benny and Hattie zoom past with stick and lid.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The chant rings round the street while Knox watches the fun move without him.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Constance watches Knox pout and sees her strict rules in his tight grip.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Constance kneels in the dust, sets a sand-timer turn plan, and picks Benny first.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Constance sings the turned share line as Knox hands the red truck to Benny.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Knox and Benny trade hauls down the street, laughing, while the timer sparkles nearby.
